summary: Plan farm visitor offers, assess rural livelihood assets and develop practical operating plans. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Agrotourism planning connects farm and rural visitor experiences with local livelihoods, operating needs and sustainability considerations. Designed for rural tourism practitioners, farm advisers and community development staff, the course builds skills in mapping livelihood assets and seasonality, shaping visitor offers, and assessing costs, site operations and community benefits. Participants also use sustainability reference points and simple monitoring tools to develop a scoped concept and action plan.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is for people who plan, advise on or operate rural visitor experiences and need to connect tourism activity with farms, local livelihoods and practical site conditions.
modules: Business Model Canvas for Farm Visits
Farm Visitor Operations and Site Risk
GSTC Criteria for Rural Visitor Offers
prerequisites: Recommended background: familiarity with a rural enterprise, farm, community initiative or visitor-service setting. No coding or specialist software skills are required.
